title: 170-odd Q-cleared witnesses of UFOs at sensitive sites

tellings.quote: See see if the 170-odd Q cleared, you know, people seeing UFOs around our most sensitive sites, shutting them down in certain cases,

plain: Michels says that some 170 people holding Q clearances, a high US security clearance for nuclear weapons work, have reported seeing UFOs around the country's most sensitive sites, and that in some cases the objects shut those sites down. He tells this himself, without naming a source. If true, it would mean unknown objects have repeatedly interfered with US nuclear facilities.
